reuse.why: Introduces one isHoliday predicate in shared/schedules and uses it at all three places that tested holiday membership (getNextDate, getDateWithSkippedWeekend, getDatesInRange).

duplication.why: The holiday rule is now single-sourced; the surrounding 'weekend or holiday' predicate is still written out three times, but that repetition predates the change and the diff does not add to it.

placement.why: The predicate sits in shared/schedules beside the date-skipping helpers that consume it, and the server code imports it from there.

scope.why: Only the holiday matching and its tests are touched.

maintainability.why: Small, readable change with one place to extend holiday formats; a shared isSkippedDay would have made it tidier still.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All holiday checks go through isHoliday.
